breve: Base class for Positional trackers managed by OpenXR's spatial entity extensions.
descricao: These are trackers created and managed by OpenXR's spatial entity extensions that give access to specific data related to OpenXR's spatial entities. They will always be of type TRACKER_ANCHOR.

metodos.desc:
Adds a new OpenXRStructureBase to the next-chain.
'get_next' will return this 'next' until either 'add_next' is called again or it's removed in 'remove_next'.

Gets the head OpenXRStructureBase in the next-chain.
See also 'add_next' and 'remove_next'.
Gets the spatial context used to create this OpenXRSpatialEntityTracker.
Removes a 'next' object previously added in 'add_next' from the next-chain.
Sets the spatial context used to create this tracker.

propriedades.desc: The spatial entity associated with this tracker.
The spatial tracking state for this tracker.

sinais.desc: Emitted when the next-chain changes, from either 'add_next' or 'remove_next'.

constantes.desc: This anchor is currently being tracked.
